## Problem

Describe the problem you want to solve. What are you trying to do that is currently impossible or painful?

## Proposed solution

Describe what you want to happen. If you have a specific API or behavior in mind, sketch it out here.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider and why did you rule them out?

## Additional context

Links to related issues, ADRs, relevant papers, or prior art.
